facts.text: I am traveling with my wife to Tokyo.
We will land at Narita airport at 14:30 on 3/16/2023.
We need to arrive at my hotel, Andaz Tokyo Toranomon Hills.
After a short break, we need to find a restaurant for dinner with local Japanese foods.
We want to see night views in Tokyo ideally close to the hotel.
After 5 days, we will depart Tokyo from Narita international airport at 13:30.
We want an itinerary that includes how to get from Narita airport to the hotel and back.
We want tourism attractions to visit in Tokyo.
We want to eat at restaurants near the tourism attractions at specific times.
We want to shop in Ginza Tokyo for fashion apparels and accessories.
We want to shop in Omotesandō for fashion apparels and accessories.
We want to see cherry blossoms in Tokyo because it is cherry blossom season.
I want to replace Day 4 with a trip to Kamakura.
I want to visit the most famous locations in Kamakura.
I want to try the best food in Kamakura.
I want to take the train by the sea in Kamakura.
I want the Day 2 and Day 3 itineraries regenerated so each day stays in one area without taking long subways back and forth.

events.text: Fly to Tokyo and land at Narita airport at 14:30
Depart Tokyo from Narita international airport at 13:30 after 5 days
Replace Day 4 with a trip to Kamakura
Regenerate Day 2 and Day 3 itineraries to minimize long subway rides
